correctness.rationale: For all primes p and all n, the denominator pn+1 is a p-adic unit, so Kummer identifies p-divisibility with carries in n+pn, giving adjacent-digit admissibility. Every finite r-digit word is a walk in symmetric anti-triangular matrix A. The cosine eigenvectors satisfy a direct finite summation identity, have norm squared (2p+1)/4 and all-ones projection (-1)^j cot(theta_j/2)/2; spectral resolution proves the exact count. Strict Perron dominance gives N_p(r) asymptotic. Cylinder counting and a telescoping positive Perron measure prove p-adic dimension. The uniform cutoff bound gives natural density zero. Exact tests checked 4449 instances. No finite verification is treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A motivated complete classification of p-nondivisible indices for the natural composite-arity p+1 Fuss–Catalan family, not merely isolated tests: exact closed all-prime power-cutoff enumerators, sharp growth constants, and a quantitative p-adic Hausdorff dimension contrasting zero natural density with dimension approaching one as p increases. Prime-power arity papers do not already provide this result. Standard binary specialization is expressly excluded from novelty.
